leadText: Kiyomasa (Japanese: キヨマサ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest. He is friends with two other Warlords, Mitsunari and Masanori.
plainText:
Kiyomasa (Japanese: キヨマサ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest. He is friends with two other Warlords, Mitsunari and Masanori.

==In the games==
 
 

===Warlord information===
====Rank I====
 

====Rank II====
 , Kiyomasa, Mitsunari, Masanori, Shingen, and Oichi having a feast]]
 
 

Transforms to Rank II by reaching a 60% link with Fraxure or Haxorus.

===Default Pokémon===
 
 
===Links===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
====Unobtainable links====
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Still snoring!"
With low health or a status ailment:
"Have you got anything left?"
When victory is near:
"It's a done deal."
Otherwise:
"Let's go, shall we...?"

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle:
"We're gonna win. It's so obvious!"
When defending a castle:
"To protect that which is dear to us!"

During battle:
"All we have to do is continue down the road we have chosen... Never mind who might try and stand in our way."

When ordering to attack:
" ! Now's the time."

When ordering to go to battle:
To a kingdom:
"Right... Let's clear a bit of a path through this battlefield, shall we?!"
To a wild Pokémon location:
"Let's hit the road!"

Upon forming a link:
"Hey, I linked with ! Come on, let's go!"

When using an item:
"Here! Take my !"

When using his Warrior Skill:
"I'll protect us all!"

After winning a battle:
If he attacked a castle:
"Take down the people who stand in our way... It's really that simple!"
If he defended a castle:
"There's nothing that we wouldn't do to protect !"

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"You're...pretty good."
If defeated by something other than the enemy:
"Gah! I messed up..."
Otherwise:
"I'm sorry, . It's all my fault."

When being recruited:
"I'm most glad to hear that! Please, use my strength as you see fit!"

When asking to go on a :
"I'd quite like to take a trip in order to train up a little. Would that be okay?"
Yes:
"Well, thanks very much! I'll be off then..."
No:
"???"

When returning from a training trip:
"I've never had so much fun on a trip before. I think the bond between and me has grown stronger, too."

===Profile===
Stubborn and very unwilling to change his own opinions. Often comes across as very sarcastic but is actually quite straightforward and pure hearted as a person.

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Kiyomasa debuted in PNA1.
 
====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==
While all other Warlord emotion sprites are kept in the exact same pose from rank to rank, the Rank I and Rank II sprites depicting one of Kiyomasa's emotions differ completely in pose.

===Historical origin===
Kiyomasa is based on the real-life of Japanese history.
